description: Azure VM pricing engine for the rate hook. Reuses the Resource Handler service principal to read NEGOTIATED prices from the customer's Azure Price Sheet (EA download-by-billing-account / MCA download-by-billing-profile, cached on disk by the companion recurring job) keyed by meterId, and falls back to the public unauthenticated Azure Retail Prices API (the Pricing Calculator's data source) for CSP/Partner subscriptions and whenever no usable negotiated sheet exists. Resolves compute, OS + data disks (by provisioned tier), Standard public IP, and the separate RHEL/SLES per-vCPU license meter, normalizing each meter's unitOfMeasure to the global rate time unit. Raw REST via requests (no Cost Management/Billing SDK in the venv). Billing-scope role (EA EnrollmentReader / MCA Billing Profile Reader) must be granted to the handler SPN for negotiated pricing.
label: Azure Pricing
name: azure_pricing
